# G06c-allow-session-mcp-tool: An MCP tool from the user's own Gemini settings (Dim Factory sends mcpServers: [] but the CLI still loads its configured servers): two session-scoped always-options; allow-session picks proceed_always_tool (first in optionPrefs). The server and tool names are redacted as a live recording's would be.
# Needs an MCP server in the fixture profile's settings.json; its name is redacted.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.gemini.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor gemini --gemini-home "<fixture GEMINI_CLI_HOME>" --bin "<node>" --entry "<the gemini package entry .js>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/gemini/acp/G06c-allow-session-mcp-tool --id G06c --slug allow-session-mcp-tool --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G06c-allow-session-mcp-tool/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G06c-allow-session-mcp-tool/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/G06c-allow-session-mcp-tool/responders.mjs --timeout 900000 -- --acp --skip-trust
